verdict.rationale: Sumsub documents two natural-language paths. Summy AI Level Builder lets users create and configure verification levels by describing requirements in plain language. An official MCP server lets AI agents perform Sumsub operations on the user's behalf, within existing role permissions. missing for 10: native in-product natural-language control beyond level building (e.g., applicant review or AML actions), documentation of which operations the MCP server exposes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
